text:
Emma: Quick sync — proposing a small milestone reset + focused MVP cut for the next launch. We need to decide which features move to v1 vs ship in MVP. Goal: keep latency-sensitive core flows and drop non-critical admin UX.
Ben: Can you call out the top 3 candidates for cut? I need to check infra deps and estimated effort.
Emma: Sure — my recommendation: 1) Tenant-level analytics dashboard -> v1, 2) Custom onboarding wizard -> v1, 3) Bulk import CSV transform -> opt-in later. Keep: API endpoints, core auth, embeddings cache, real-time routing.
Clara: UX note — dropping the onboarding wizard means we should add inline tooltips and a short setup checklist so customers don't get confused. 2-3 microcopy items, ~1 day.
Diego: Flag from sales — Nimbus (pilot customer) said onboarding wizard is a blocker for their SSO pilot. If we defer, they want a documented manual flow and a dedicated CX touch for pilot week.
Emma: Good catch. Proposal: do deferred wizard but provide a documented runbook + assign a CSM for Nimbus pilot. That should be acceptable and keeps schedule.
Ben: Technically the biggest risk is the bulk CSV transform — it touches ETL and worker autoscaling. If we drop it from MVP we can reduce one infra spike. Agree it's safe to postpone.
Ava: Product tradeoff: how are we defining "MVP" here? Is it feature-complete for pilot customers or just technically viable?
Emma: MVP = technically solid and covers core tenant flows for pilot customers, not 100% feature parity. v1 milestone is when we add admin UX and bulk ops for GA.
infra-bot: Reminder: next capacity planning window closes in 48h. Please update the "milestone-ship" labels in Jira so infra can plan GPU reservations. :robot_face:
Ben: Action items for eng: 1) add feature-flag gates for onboarding wizard and CSV import (est 2 dev-days), 2) size autoscaling for current traffic projections without bulk import, 3) document fallbacks.
Clara: UX action: create 3 tooltip copies + setup checklist doc (owner: Clara, due EOD Wed). I'll put a minimal screen mock in Figma.
Diego: Sales action: confirm Nimbus alignment — I'll get them the runbook and schedule a CX session next Thu.
Emma: OK — decision: postpone onboarding wizard and bulk CSV import to v1. Plan: ship MVP as-is with tooltips + runbook. Timeline shift: move v1 milestone +3 weeks to allow QA and docs. Can we accept the +3w knock to marketing calendar?
Ben: +3 weeks is doable if we freeze any additional new features. We should update the release branch policy and cut a hard freeze one week before staging handoff.
Ava: Agree. Also recommend a short canary: enable the tenant analytics dashboard behind a flag for 5 pilot accounts post-MVP, so we can iterate before full v1 rollout.
Emma: Good call. I'll add canary plan to the milestone doc and assign owners.
infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-4721 "MVP milestone reset — reserve capacity" (assignee: eng-infra). Link: https://jira.redwood/INF-4721
Ben: I'll open WIP PR for feature flags today and add a checklist in the PR template: "feature-flagged, docs updated, telemetry added".
Emma: Final: owners — Ben (eng) for flags & infra, Clara (design) for tooltips, Diego (sales) for Nimbus liaison, Ava (product) for canary plan. I'll file a milestone update and ping marketing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
